description: POWER Project Services Platform is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NASA Langley Research Center; NASA Earthdata, Atmospheric Science Data Center; CERES (Clouds and Earth's Radiance Energy) Mission. This site provides solar and meteorological data sets from NASA research for support of renewable energy, building energy efficiency, and agricultural needs. The platform offers numerous methods to obtain data products, including a Data Access Viewer, Web image services, and direct access through URL commands. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
